prompt: Write the body (about 180 words) of a demand letter from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer before a lawsuit. Accident: side impact at intersection. Injury: concussion. Use the exact placeholders [CLIENT_NAME], [LOSS_DATE] and [DEMAND_AMOUNT]. No other names or dates. (Internal reference C-1320; do not mention it.)
text:
Our office represents [CLIENT_NAME] in connection with the side-impact collision that occurred at a signalized intersection on [LOSS_DATE]. Our client was proceeding through the intersection on a green light when your insured's vehicle entered from a cross street and struck the driver's side of our client's car. The force of the impact spun the vehicle and caused the driver's head to strike the side window and airbag housing.

As a direct result of the collision, our client was diagnosed with a concussion. Symptoms have included persistent headaches, light sensitivity, dizziness, and difficulty concentrating, and our client has been unable to work full duty while recovering. Treating physicians have recommended ongoing neurological follow-up and a graduated return to daily activities.

The liability picture is straightforward. Your insured had a duty to yield the right of way and failed to do so, and the physical evidence and independent witness statements support our client's account of the events. There is no reasonable basis to attribute fault to our client.

Accordingly, we demand payment of [DEMAND_AMOUNT] to resolve all claims arising from this collision. This offer will remain open for thirty days from the date of this letter. If we do not receive a satisfactory response within that period, we are authorized to file suit without further notice.
